title: 02 · Laptop on a desk: Halde Architekten
strengths: The photograph is real, well chosen and empty of people and brands; the credit line with one red dot is the right amount of text
The Halde hero is fitted to the screen at the right aspect and stays sharp
slop_signals: The keyboard is a grid of identical black rounded rectangles with no legends, no gaps for the function row, no space bar: the single biggest tell that the laptop is drawn, not photographed
The laptop casts almost no contact shadow and no ambient occlusion on the oak, while the photo's light clearly comes from the upper left; the silver base shows no warm reflection from the table
The screen is pasted: full brightness, no glass reflection, no vignette, while the wall and table carry grain and soft light
The silhouette (silver slab, black bezel, wide trackpad, thin lid) is a MacBook outline without a logo rather than a generic machine
Composition: the laptop takes a quarter of the frame and sits in the lower third under a large empty plaster wall; the ratio says 'template with a photo behind it'
fixes: Photograph or source an open-licence laptop on a similar table and perspective-map the hero onto its screen (the Squarespace and Poly references show the result)
If it must stay CSS: draw real key legends and gaps, a space bar, a hinge; add a soft contact shadow and occlusion under the base and a warm gradient on the silver facing the oak
Lay a 4 to 6% white diagonal reflection over the screen and a slight vignette toward the bezel
Crop so the laptop fills at least 60% of the width; or move the camera closer and lower

references.what: Photographed laptop on a table: real keyboard, hinge and reflections; the screen is the brightest thing but it shares the room's light
Laptop photographed at an angle with hands and objects; the device belongs to the scene
UI composited onto a photographed wood desk with matched shadows; proves a composite can pass when the light matches
A laptop inside a photographed scene; the machine is part of the picture, not a frame on top of it

owner.said: when designs are bad, mockups will also be bad; work on them

changed: Alt text rewritten for the rebuilt hero 01 (one building section with sun angles)
remaining: Unchanged reasons for 2: legend-less CSS keyboard, MacBook outline with thumb notch, no hinge, flat lighting
Replaced by mockups/09 and out of the gallery: owner to decide whether to keep or remove it
